verdict.line: You lose the pre-6 trades and the solo-kill race if you let her rip your spirit near a wall, but Fiora's level-6 answer and mid-game item spikes turn this into a 52.8% win rate over 710 games.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's Harsh Lesson (W) has only a 4s cooldown and her Test of Spirit (E) punishes you whether you fight or flee, so she wins the pure lane and the solo-kill numbers before level 6. Fiora has no ability that answers the spirit tether early, but at level 6 Riposte (W) becomes a direct counter to her ultimate, and from there Ravenous Hydra and Trinity Force let Fiora out-skirmish and split-push past a lane she was always going to lose on paper.

theirWindow.what: She'll rip your spirit, often near a wall where her passive tentacles spawn. If you stand and fight the spirit the damage it takes echoes back to you; if you run too far or let it die you become a Vessel that spawns tentacles and feeds her sustain. Get outside her 900 range before the tether resolves instead of trading into it.

yourWindow.when: Her Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: Lunge in with Q, then again for free within the next couple seconds, land an auto, and burn E (Burst of Speed) so each landed hit stacks move speed. Get out before Tentacle Smash or Harsh Lesson come off cooldown.

powerCurve.note: Harsh Lesson's 4s cooldown outpaces your trades
Test of Spirit forces a lose-lose trade
Riposte now answers her Leap of Faith
Hydra and Trinity win extended skirmishes

start.why: Extra AD and sustain to win short trades before her E tether can snowball into free tentacle damage; 52.3% win rate over 800 games at 92% pick.

boots.why: Illaoi's autos, tentacle swings, and Harsh Lesson procs are all physical damage, so flat reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads here; 51.5% win rate at 73.8% pick.

core.why: Sustain and wave clear to answer her tentacle poke without losing CS.
Damage and move speed spike that lets you punish her low mobility once Riposte is up.
Physical damage mitigation and healing to survive her all-in windows after a bad Test of Spirit.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to burst her down during a Q/E cooldown window
she's shoving you under tower with tentacles and you need wave control
her passive tentacle and Vessel healing is keeping her alive in extended trades
their other laners bring heavy magic damage or hard crowd control

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the double-Lunge-into-auto trade pattern with a burst window, punishing her before her echo and tentacle sustain can offset the damage; 53.6% win rate at 9.4% pick.

summoners.why: Ignite's healing reduction cuts directly into her passive tentacle self-heal during all-ins, and it's the dominant pick at 92.7% for a 52.1% win rate; Flash pairs with Lunge to extend engages or escape the spirit tether.

playing.title: Give ground when her E is up
playing.detail: Avoid standing inside her 900-range Test of Spirit when it's off cooldown, especially near walls where her passive tentacles spawn.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Illaoi's passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassable terrain that swing at you and heal her, so pull trades toward open lane.

playing.title: Trade with the double Lunge
playing.detail: Q can be recast within a couple seconds at no mana cost; use both hits plus an auto in one in-and-out window.

playing.title: Save Riposte for her autos
playing.detail: Riposte parries her next basic attack, not Harsh Lesson itself, so hold it for the auto she throws out after the leap.

playing.title: Block her ultimate at 6
playing.detail: Once you hit level 6, hold W to answer her Leap of Faith directly instead of trying to out-damage it.

playing.title: Build to outlast her sustain
playing.detail: If her Vessel and tentacle healing is carrying trades, pick up Executioner's Calling to shut it down.

playing.title: Use Blade Waltz on skirmishes, not duels
playing.detail: R dashes to and damages nearby enemy champions with reduced damage on repeat hits, so it's better spent erasing a squishy in a group fight than soloing Illaoi under her tentacles.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and pick rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the tactical reading — trade timing, wall positioning, and the level-6 Riposte answer — is my own judgement.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Illaoi’s (E) while laning. Use [Q] to contest lane and gain control before reaching level 6. After reaching level 6, use [W] to block her (R).
